info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to speak, to tell, to state, to explain, to narrate

examples: 'yAvanniHSreyasaM vAkyaM kiYcit prakaTayAmyaham' (rA॰5.1.93). prakaTayAmyuccArayAmItyarTaH.  atra praSabdaH saNkoce paricCede vartate.  DAtvarTaM vAkyaprabanDamuktimAtre paryavasAyayati.
'tvayA saNkaTyamAnena mahimnA sAtvatAM pate. nAtitfpyati me cittam …' (BA॰pu॰8.5.13).. saNkaTyamAnena=saNkIrtyamAnena=upavarRyamAnena=aBizwUyamAnena.
'devamivAcAryamupAsItA'vikaTayan' (Apa0 Da0 1.2.6.13). avikaTayan=vyarTAM kaTAmakurvan. kaTAdiByazWaka (4.4.102) sUtre vikaTeti paWyate. vyarTA kaTA vikaTA. vikaTAyAM sADuH pravIRo vEkaTikaH.
'yataH kAvyasya praBedA muktakaM…paryAyabanDaH parikaTA… ityevamAdayaH' (DvanyA0 3.7 vyAKyAyAm). DarmAdipuruzArTAnyatamADikaraRakaH kaTAsaNgrahaH parikaTA.
